race.comment: FANTASY CROWNED (6) returned from a spell two weeks ago when he was beaten into seventh over 1100m at Dubbo. This doesn't look as hard and can play a big role. GO BABY (9) missed the placings two runs back then didn't do any better last start when in eighth over 1300m at Dubbo. Finds a nice race and can bounce back. MS REEVES (4) won nicely two back before a disappointing effort when racing over further at Grenfell last time out. Back to 1200m now is a big tick and she can run an improved race. BITTA BON MAGIC (7) went 1000m to 1400m for his last couple of runs and now comes back to 1200m which looks a good move. Can run a better race under this scenario.
